**Complexity analysis**: This is one of the most complex helper functions in the Tekton library because Tekton task references can take many forms depending on:
1. **Resolver type**: bundle (old-style), bundles (new resolver), git, or local
2. **SLSA version**: v0.2 vs v1.0 attestation formats have different structures
3. **Reference type**: Inlined task definitions vs external references

**Implementation strategy**: Use cascading conditionals with `else` clauses to handle each case in precedence order:

**Case 1 - Old-style bundle**: Check for `.bundle` attribute directly on the ref. Parse with `image.parse()` to extract digest (pinned) and tag info. Generate a unique key for the bundle.

**Case 2 - Bundle resolver**: Check for `resolver == "bundles"`. Extract bundle URI from params. Parse similarly to case 1.

**Case 3 - Git resolver**: Check for `resolver == "git"`. Extract url, revision, and pathInRepo from params. Normalize the git URL (add "git+" prefix and ".git" suffix). Determine if revision is a SHA1 (40-char hex) to set pinned status.

**Case 4 - Inlined tasks**: Empty ref means the task definition is embedded directly. Use special sentinel values like `"<NAMELESS>"` and `"<INLINED>"`.

**Case 5 - Local references**: Fallback for cluster-local task references.

**Helper functions needed**: `_param()` to extract resolver parameters, `_ref()` to normalize ref location across formats, `_ref_name()` to get task name with fallback logic, `_with_pinned_ref()` and `_with_tagged_ref()` to conditionally add pinned/tagged metadata.

**Key design choice**: The precedence order matches Tekton's actual resolution logic, ensuring policies accurately reflect runtime behavior.

slsa_provenance_predicate_type_v02 := "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v0.2"

	count(data["required-tasks"]) == 0

latest_required_default_tasks := ectime.newest(data["required-tasks"])

# The set of required tasks that are required right now.
current_required_default_tasks := ectime.most_current(data["required-tasks"])

tasks(obj) := {task |
	some maybe_task in _maybe_tasks(obj)
	task := _slsa_task(maybe_task)
}

_slsa_task(task) := task if {
	# tasks in slsa v0.2 have a 'results' section, while tasks in slsa v1 have a
	# 'status.results' section.
	#
	# the check below ensures that, in case we're dealing with a slsa v1 attestation,
	# we apply the correct task info extraction
	not task.status.results
	ref := task_ref(task)
	ref.kind == "task"
}

_slsa_task(task) := complete_task if {
	task.status.results

	ref := task_ref(task)
	ref.kind == "task"

	extra_fields := object.union(
		{"results": task.status.results},
		_slsav1_task_params(task),
	)

	complete_task := object.union(task, extra_fields)
}

_slsav1_task_params(task) := {"params": task.spec.params} if {
	task.spec.params
	count(task.spec.params) > 0

# _maybe_tasks returns a set of potential tasks.
# Handle tasks from a PipelineRun attestation (SLSA v0.2).

	given.statement.predicateType == slsa_provenance_predicate_type_v02
}

# Handle tasks from a Pipeline definition.
_maybe_tasks(given) := _tasks if {
	given.spec
	spec := object.get(given, "spec", {})

		object.get(spec, "tasks", []),
		object.get(spec, "finally", []),
	)

# https://github.com/tektoncd/chains/blob/main/docs/predicate/slsa/v2.md#provenance-example-for-in-lined-buildconfig.

	given.statement.predicateType == slsa_provenance_predicate_type_v1
	resolved_deps := given.statement.predicate.buildDefinition.resolvedDependencies
	tasks := [task |
		some dep in resolved_deps
		dep.name == "pipelineTask"
		dep.content

	some task in tasks(obj)
	some name in task_names(task)

	raw_name := task_name(task)

	not task.name

	task.params
	count(task.params) == 0

# slsa v1.0 step image

	count(trim_space(url)) > 0

source_build_tasks(attestation) := [task |
	some task in tasks(attestation)

	r := task_ref(task)

	# Task was the input, provided either as input to the task rules or SLSA v1

	labels := task.metadata.labels

**Design rationale**: The separation of `most_current()` (filters by time) and `newest()` (just sorts) enables two use cases:

#

# currently we're not using any scopes except for the rule scope.

		some metadata in metadata_chain
		metadata.annotations.scope in scope_precedence

	# value if effective_on was not found in annotations

# present, otherwise use the real current time

	data.config

	not data.config

# items is empty, or no items are current, most_current does not produce a

		some i in items
		i.effective_on
		not time.parse_rfc3339_ns(i.effective_on) > effective_current_time_ns
	]

	item := newest(current)
}

# newest returns the newest item by `effective_on`. Assumes same date format and
# time-zone for `effective_on` field.
newest(items) := item if {
	ordered := arrays.sort_by("effective_on", items)

	item := ordered[count(ordered) - 1]
}
